name: Hikami Fuuka
source:
The main heroine of this work. She is a member of the cheerleading club at Kamuro high school.

She has a cheerful personality, but she is weak against pushiness and passive-aggression. She joined the cheerleading club on the recommendation of her younger sister.

She has excellent grades in academics, but has no athletic ability. She is a calm girl with an submissive temperament.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080214215833/http://www.finish-game.com/games/cheergirl/cha1_chara.html] archived official site[/url]]
